subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should #43367 remain the umbrella tracker while narrower session-lock, delivery, fallback-lane, and metadata-only completion fixes land, or should maintainers split those paths now and close the umbrella after linking them?
rationale: The remaining work spans both proven bugs and product-level orchestration semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent boundary for subagent isolation, cancellation, durable delivery, and operator visibility.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Plus Narrow Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open as the routing umbrella while reviewing PR #86540 and the narrower canonical issues, then reassess closure after merged proof.

options.title: Split Then Close Later
options.body: Promote the remaining root causes to explicit canonical issues and close this umbrella only after those links and owners are clear.

options.title: Sponsor Orchestration Redesign
options.body: Treat the token-ring or metadata-only completion path as a product-design effort rather than a bug-sweep repair.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Plus Narrow Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the routing umbrella while reviewing PR #86540 and the narrower canonical issues, then reassess closure after merged proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue crosses architecture policy, session locks, subagent lifecycle, and current vision boundaries where this history trail is strongest.
